facebook.caption: Tourists keep walking past this. Guan Di Temple on Đường Trần Hưng Đạo is one of the most atmospheric stops in Phu Quoc and almost nobody on the resort circuit knows it exists. Red lanterns, incense smoke, complete quiet. A working temple that locals actually use. Takes 20 minutes. Costs nothing. Hits different when every other hour of your trip is a beach bar. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
facebook.video_caption: Incense rising, lanterns overhead, zero other tourists. Guan Di Temple is 20 minutes from the main strip and feels like a completely different island. Free entry. Go early.

instagram.caption: Locals don't post about Guan Di Temple. Red lanterns, real incense, zero crowds. Free entry, 20 mins from the strip. Tag your travel buddy.
instagram.video_caption: Walk in. Incense hits you first. Then the red lanterns. Then the silence. Guan Di Temple, Phu Quoc. Free. Empty.
